description.value: Heritage Acres is a heritage museum run by the Saanich Historical Artifacts Society, showcasing historic farm buildings, vintage tractors, steam engines, and harvest equipment on the Saanich Peninsula. The grounds include walking trails and a miniature railway operated by the Vancouver Island Model Engineers (VIME), with public rides available on scheduled dates throughout the season. Situated on Lochside Drive—a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting Sidney to Victoria—it makes a distinctive cultural detour for cyclists exploring the peninsula.
